The New Attendance App 1 / 6
Secondary staff briefing · November 2026

The New
Attendance App

As part of the AIS initiative to educate parents and students about the importance of school attendance, and how it affects student learning, we have launched the new Attendance App.

Every week

From iSAMS to a report and a story

STEP 1

iSAMS data

Attendance, punctuality and recognition awards, exported every week, thanks to Mr Leon.

STEP 2

Reconciled

Each week we reconcile the data, so every student's figures are checked and up to date.

STEP 3

Report and animation

A personal report for every student, along with some cute animations of their week.

By email, every week

Parents and students both receive it

Parents · MondayOne email per family, a button for each child
Students · TuesdayTo their own school email address

They receive a link to the student's report and, if they choose to, they can watch the animation at the start.

First send (5 to 6 November): 1,023 families and 1,879 students.
This week's real parent email
Secondary Recognition Awards

Every recognition counts

At the request of Miss Erin, Miss Rana and the RTC team, the animation also includes all Secondary Recognition Award notes entered into iSAMS.

At 4, 8, 12 or 16 recognitions, students also earn Mr Boyd's medal, recognised with a physical certificate and at assemblies.

Mr Boyd's medals
Open in a new tab
In iSAMS: Reward & Conduct Manager

Every note you enter here goes home

All the notes and recognitions you enter as a Secondary Recognition Award in iSAMS are sent to parents and students every week.

Driving engagement even further

What's next for students

Weekly draw: a common room voucher

Students go to the app and go into a draw to win a weekly common room voucher.

Thanks, Mr Steve

Top 20 students: an excursion

At the end of each term, the top 20 students go on an excursion.

Starting next term

Animations become games

My ICT class and I will vibe code these animations into games, with every student's name on a live scoreboard to drive competition.
